item.title: Group health sharing starts after approval
item.summary: When you approve an exact health share in a Murph group, Murph now starts preparing it right away and tells the group while the shared view is still getting ready.
item.details: Pending shares stay unranked and do not trigger another permission request or a guess about device status. Reapproving a recent-data share starts a fresh preparation instead of briefly reusing an older view, and preparation retries safely if the first attempt fails. Sleep-sharing prompts also state that sleep timing and duration cover the last seven days, with the same exact permission and privacy boundaries.
